articles.title: Odelein dies at 58, was first Blue Jackets captain
Canadiens, Banque Nationale partner on premium space at Bell Centre
Lines and defense pairings at practice – Oct. 5

away.summary: The Carolina Hurricanes are coming off a 3-2 overtime win over the Philadelphia Flyers, with Pyotr Kochetkov starting in net. They have a strong power play, scoring three of their five goals on the man advantage. Seth Jarvis is returning to the lineup after missing time due to shoulder surgery.

out.detail: lower body injury, expected out 2-4 weeks

home.summary: The Montreal Canadiens are coming off a 6-5 overtime loss to the Pittsburgh Penguins, with Jakub Dobes starting in net. They have a strong team with captain Nick Suzuki leading the charge, and Florian Xhekaj is making his season debut. Several key players are sidelined due to injuries.
